official_public_authority.description: Official Maine or federal legal authority acquired from authoritative public sources.

public_non_official_source.description: Public legal information that is not official authority, such as public mirrors or explainers.

licensed_secondary_source.description: Treatises, CLE materials, practice guides, or secondary sources subject to license terms.

user_provided_confidential_matter_data.description: User-uploaded pleadings, exhibits, correspondence, transcripts, or work product.

synthetic_eval_data.description: Synthetic benchmark and smoke-test records with no private client facts.

attorney_reviewed_eval_data.description: Attorney-reviewed examples approved for eval use after privacy and licensing review.

model_artifact.description: Model weights, adapter files, tokenizers, embeddings, and derived model artifacts.

audit_record.description: Immutable operational records showing user, matter, source, model, prompt, output, verifier, and export status.
